description: This is a PHP source file for the EmployeeLeaveRequestAPI class, which implements REST API endpoints for managing employee leave requests within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes CRUD operations, validation, and access control logic specific to leave requests.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveRequestAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to manage employee leave requests, including retrieval, creation, and update operations, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieve a specific leave request by ID, optionally returning detailed information based on 'model' parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: List all leave requests, possibly filtered by date range, statuses, employee, subunit, and other parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Create a new leave request for an employee, handling leave allocation, validation, and optionally returning detailed info.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update a leave request's status via action (approve, reject, cancel), with validation for multiple statuses and allowed actions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single leave request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing leave requests with filter parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a leave request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a leave request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws exception if called.
